title: About the Center
text:
Our Core Agendas


01. Infrastructure


Building the Foundation
Research in technology-education is only as good as its measurement. CATER focuses on the development of validated psychometric scales and open-source methodological tools that allow researchers to capture the nuance of digital learning.





02. Translation


From Data to Action
We believe that research is incomplete until it is accessible. Our translation wing develops teacher-ready toolkits and provides evidence-based briefings for policy stakeholders, ensuring that the “Frontiers of Research” are reachable by the classroom.





03. Accelerator


The CATER Network
Inspired by large-scale collaborative models, our Accelerator supports rapid, multi-site data collection. By pooling resources and expertise, our members can execute high-powered studies that would be impossible for a single lab.
